meta.title: Luxury Catered Chalet in Méribel, 3 Valleys — Chalet Yolo
meta.description: Chalet Yolo, a luxury catered chalet in Méribel with private chef and butler, heated indoor pool and spa. Six bedrooms for 15 guests in Les 3 Vallées.

intro.text: Five levels, 350 m², a private chef, a butler and a chauffeur. At Chalet Yolo, the only decision of the day: the slopes or the spa.

pool.text: Back from the slopes, the heated water is waiting. A private indoor pool, for a few lengths or a long moment of doing nothing at all.

wellness.title: Spa and wellness area
wellness.text: Sauna, hammam, Jacuzzi: the après-ski ritual, without leaving the chalet. Legs heavy from the day don't stand a chance.

cinema.text: As night falls over the valley, the home cinema takes over. A family film or the evening match, safe from the cold.

livingRoom.text: Beneath the beams of the cathedral-ceiling living room, the fire crackles and the long table is laid. This is where the day's stories are told, over the chef's cooking.

meribel.title: At the heart of Les 3 Vallées
meribel.text: Resort founded in {foundedYear} · {skiAreaKm} km of slopes · Savoyard architecture.
